blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Malacañang on Tuesday said allegations that entities linked to the Dutertes received money from China should be thoroughly investigated, warning that it is dangerous to deal with a “Manchurian candidate.” This came after former Surigao del Norte Rep. Robert Ace Barbers said the alleged transfers of nearly P470 million from China to a company owned by Manases Carpio, Vice President Sara Duterte’s husband, and to a foundation she had established could be used for foreign-funded destabilization.
